name: Phenytoin
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Drugs that raise phenytoin (azole antifungals, fluoxetine, sertraline, cimetidine, omeprazole, co-trimoxazole, amiodarone, isoniazid, capecitabine, warfarin, acute alcohol)
key_interactions.action: Monitor phenytoin levels; adjust the dose.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Drugs that lower phenytoin (carbamazepine, ritonavir, nelfinavir, cisplatin, carboplatin, methotrexate, folic acid, chronic alcohol)
key_interactions.effect: Lower phenytoin levels; loss of seizure control (label).
key_interactions.action: Monitor phenytoin levels; adjust the dose.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Drugs metabolized by liver enzymes that phenytoin induces (corticosteroids, warfarin, oral contraceptives, many others)
key_interactions.effect: Phenytoin is a potent enzyme inducer and lowers their levels (label).
